reference.source: runway.center is the world projection of 11.228 N 125.028 E, cross-checked against the Copernicus source tiles 2026-09-14 and carried by tests/tools/terrainBuild.test.ts; taken verbatim, never re-derived (master spec §15). headingDeg 0: the strip runs north-south because that is where the ground is flat (src/render/spawn.ts's measurement, 2026-09-17). lengthM 1500 and widthM 45 are ESTIMATES carried from Plan 11a (see the former runway.ts comments, 2026-09-16). apron and clearing reproduce the Codex scenery pass of 2026-09-17 (daa1b39) exactly. A parked entity's placeholder altitude (PARKED_PLACEHOLDER_Y_M, src/sim/scenario.ts) is not the real ground height at runway.center: measured 2026-09-16, it is 1.673 m at L4 (the only level physicsFieldFor ever hands the physics) versus 1.921 m at L0 (the finest tile) -- a 0.25 m gap, exactly GROUND_CONTACT_TOLERANCE_M -- which is why settleOnTerrain (src/render/frame.ts) overwrites it the instant a real field lands rather than trusting the placeholder for physics.
